title: AI – Driven Virtual Instructor for 3D Virtual Electronics Lab
summary: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University plans a nine-month pilot of an AI instructor for a 3D electronics lab; no source reports a result.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University in Ethiopia and its partner O-SKILLS PLC plan a nine-month pilot of a virtual electronics laboratory. In an International Telecommunication Union report of June 2025, the team describes AI feedback and support in Amharic. The account states that students of the university would build the AI instructor and that O-SKILLS would build the 3D lab. It reports no gains in access or skills. On 29 October 2026 the O-SKILLS Visual Hub page offered a waitlist for its 3D simulated labs. The page does not mention the AI instructor or a pilot result.
purpose: Make practical electronics learning accessible without full physical laboratories.
system: AI virtual instructor for a 3D electronics laboratory
developer: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University and O-SKILLS PLC

data.answer:
An Ethiopian project plans a nine-month virtual-lab pilot with AI feedback and Amharic support. Access and skill gains remain prospective.

The roadmap still calls for constructing a proof-of-concept prototype. Planned language support and a virtual lab do not demonstrate improved skills, participation, or gender equity. The proposed pilot's length is not an observation period with completed outcomes.

The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.
